description: This file manages the registration, validation, and unregistration of a service worker for a React web application, including handling localhost scenarios and offline caching.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the service worker if in production environment and supported by the browser, handling localhost and cross-origin scenarios.

methods.name: registerValidSW
methods.description: Handles the actual registration of the service worker and manages update events.

methods.name: checkValidServiceWorker
methods.description: Checks if the service worker exists and is valid; reloads page if not found.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters the service worker if supported.
